Wizoobs are ghost enemies that disappear, then reappear near Isaac and spit a cluster of spectral tears at him. While they can appear to any side of Isaac, they most often will appear below him.


Notes

  • They can spawn in unique Devil Room layouts if Isaac is holding the Number Magnet.

Variations

Red Ghosts behave the same as Wizoobs, but fire a Brimstone beam instead of spectral shots.


Gallery

  • Sketches of monsters for the Binding of Isaac: Rebirth, including the Wizoob in the sixth square of the third row. In the concept art, it's originally called "Wizoos."

Trivia

  • Wizoobs may be a reference to Wizrobes from The Legend of Zelda due to their similar names, similar sound effects, and attack patterns.
  • They could be a reference to Boos from the Super Mario series as well, considering that they look and act like boos, as well as having "boo" spelled backward at the end of their name.
  • Wizoobs and Red Ghosts are the only entities in the game whose Stage HPs were reduced in Repentance.
